subject: MSA intake: signer mapping, Exhibit A scope and initial redline asks
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helion.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Helion Legal <legal@helion.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MSA for review + Exhibit A details

Hi Neha / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached is our standard MSA (PDF) and a first-pass Exhibit A with the feature list and expected monthly seat counts (xlsx). We're hoping to get an initial read and any obvious non-starter flags from Redwood legal before we loop in procurement on our side.

Top asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood's standard data residency/cross-border language (we're US-based but have EU customers)
- Any clauses you expect to redline around audit rights / SOC evidence access
- Clarify signer authority: Helion prefers C-level signatory for MSAs > $250k ARR; we can provide a signer matrix.

We'd like to aim for a first-pass consolidated redline by EOD Thursday (6/17) so our procurement team can internalize changes. Can Kimberly or Neha confirm who should be the initial reviewer on Redwood's side?

Attachments: [Attachment: Helion_MSA_Draft_20260615.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: ExhibitA_Scope_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Best,
Samira
Head of Partnerships
Helion AI
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helion.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA for review + Exhibit A details

Hi Samira —

Thanks for sending the draft and the Exhibit A. Kimberly will be the primary contracts reviewer; I'm looping Jonas (legal ops) and Rishi (commercial lead) to pick up signer/finance questions. Quick notes / next steps: 

1) Intake checklist we need from Helion for the kickoff:
   - Final list of expected bill-to entities and their jurisdictions (simple table)
   - Signer authority matrix (who can sign MSAs vs. SOWs)
   - If Exhibit A contains personal data from EU customers, flag the rows and indicate residency needs

2) On timing: Kimberly expects to have a first-pass redline by 6/17 EOD if there are only template-level changes. If we hit substantive commercial terms, we may need an extra day.

3) A couple of likely redline areas (advance heads-up):
   - Audit / SOC access: we'll ask for a targeted 'evidence request' approach vs full audit rights for hosted hosted/private options
   - Data residency: we'll propose carveouts and clear routing for cross-border requests
   - Liability caps: we may try to align caps to subscription fees; Rishi will advise on commercial floor

Samira — could you confirm the billing entity and whether any EU-owned subsidiaries will be covered under this MSA? Also confirm whether Helion's security team can accept a one-pager SOC2 evidence bundle (we'll share links).

I'll send an internal assignment note to legal to prioritize once we get the billing entity.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@helion.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA for review + Exhibit A details

Samira / team —

I pulled a quick pass on the draft overnight and flagged three items I'll call out in the consolidated redline:

• Section 7 (Data Processing / Residency): I'll mark requested residency language and propose a short residency SLA in Exhibit A. If Helion plans to route EU customer data to EU-only storage, call that out in the Exhibit rows.

• Section 12 (Audit & Evidence): I will propose an evidence-based alternative to broad audit rights — we typically provide SOC2 report access and a contractual commitment to support reasonable, scoped audits. If Helion needs full audit rights, note the specific business justification so we can evaluate.

• Section 16 (Indemnities / Caps): There are a couple of one-off indemnity asks in Helion's draft that are outside our template; I'll flag them and propose alternative language tied to claim types.

Request for Helion: can you add a short column in Exhibit A marking which features are 'hosted' vs 'private deploy' (this affects residency and support SLAs)? That will let me tailor service-level and hosting clauses per feature.

I plan to circulate a consolidated redline with comments tomorrow (6/17) by 4pm PT. If that timing works, we can schedule a 30-min sync early next week to walk through major tradeoffs.

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

I've updated Exhibit A (new column: Hosting_Type) and added the billing entity row (Helion AI, Inc., Delaware). Our procurement lead is keen on a quick path — 30-min legal sync would be great. We're available Monday 6/21 between 10–12 PT. Please send a calendar invite if that works.

Best,
Samira

Helion AI
